samir: heads-up: ran into an annoying parity gap between REST and JS SDK when creating multipart webhook+auth routes. REST accepts `webhook: { url, secret, headers }` but SDK drops `headers` entirely.

elaine: repro steps? which sdk version?

samir: sdk-js v1.1.3, sample-apps/webhooks. snippet: ```js
await client.routes.create({
  name: 'webhook-route',
  model: 'gpt-lite',
  webhook: { url: 'https://hook.me', secret: 's3cr3t', headers: { 'x-env': 'staging' } }
})
// -> server sees url+secret but no headers
```

rob: do you have proxied payload? could be JSON marshalling or a type mismatch (map vs record).

samir: proxied body: `{ "name": "webhook-route", "model": "gpt-lite", "webhook": { "url": "https://hook.me", "secret": "***" } }` — headers missing. curl with identical body works.

elaine: also note retry difference: REST retries on 5xx once, SDK retries 3x with exponential which caused duplicate webhooks firing to downstream. Customer noticed doubled events.

rob: sounds like two issues: field omission (codegen/serializer) + retry policy divergence. I'll check generator flags for map serialization and the SDK retry wrapper.

ci-bot: Created issue redwood/sdk-js#220: "JS SDK: webhook.headers omitted from payload; SDK retry policy stronger than REST" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/220 :robot_face:

dx-bot: suggested fix: regen SDK models with explicit Record<string,string> mapping; add parity e2e that diffs SDK JSON -> curl JSON for routes endpoints.

samir: temporary workaround: switching to direct fetch/curl in sample-apps webhook demo, and adding idempotency token on POST to avoid duplicates. PR incoming. :+1:

elaine: marking P1 for parity backlog; assign to sdk-js team. rob, can you add the parity CI test?

rob: on it. will also audit other endpoints that accept headers/maps (notifications, cache).

samir: thanks all. will update the sample-app README once PR merges.
